import numpy as np

# Baseline calculation points: avg of 1100±10 and 1800±10
mask_b1 = (x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)
mask_b2 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)

# Handle case where no points fall in range (unlikely with dense data but safe)
if mask_b1.sum() > 0 and mask_b2.sum() > 0:
    b1_val = y1[mask_b1].mean()
    b2_val = y1[mask_b2].mean()
else:
    b1_val = y1[0]
    b2_val = y1[-1]

# Generate baseline line
baseline = np.interp(x, [x[mask_b1][0], x[mask_b2][-1]], [b1_val, b2_val])
if mask_b1.sum() == 0:
     # Fallback if start point missing from mask logic above, use global min/max indices for interpolation anchors roughly
     pass 

# Subtract baseline
y_corrected = y1 - baseline

# Normalize G band (1550-1620) to 1
mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
if mask_g.sum() > 0:
    g_max = y_corrected[mask_g].max()
    if g_max != 0:
        y_final = y_corrected / g_max
    else:
        y_final = y_corrected
else:
    y_final = y_corrected

y1 = y_final
